note: Met 49.135.2 rectangular fangding (12th–11th c. BCE). Published H 229, W 152, D 178 mm (Met API 22.9 / 15.2 / 17.8 cm) — W and D are flange-to-flange spans; the LONG face carries the published D. Proportions measured on the originals DP140736 (front.jpg, long face head-on, 0.0903 mm/px from the overall height) and DP140737 (side.jpg, short face head-on, 0.181 mm/px); see dossier.md. Axes: long axis X (handles on the ±X short sides), front (+Z) = a long face. Parts: body = walls + floor + slab rim (no flanges, legs, handles); flanges = 4 corner (45°) + 4 face-centre flanges; legs = 4 roots; handles = 2 roots.
